descriptor: Developer portfolio built as a green-screen terminal

voice.summary: Phosphor writes like a man page with a sense of humour: terse, lowercase-friendly and full of understated commands. It uses dry in-jokes for those who recognise them and plain help text for everyone else.
dos: Answer commands with one clear line
Use technical words accurately and sparingly
donts: Avoid long paragraphs in the terminal
Never leave a command without feedback

boilerplate: Phosphor is a developer's portfolio disguised as a green-screen terminal, where projects, skills and contact details are all one typed command away.

microcopy.error: Command not found. Type help for a list.
microcopy.empty: No history yet. Type a command and press Enter.

logo.note: A prompt chevron is the pure symbol of a command line.
